2.284.16
CustomReportItem.Style
The CustomReportItem.Style element specifies the Style element of a CustomReportItem element.
The CustomReportItem.Style element is optional and MUST NOT be specified more than once. If
this element is present, it is of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the CustomReportItem.Style element.
Parent elements
CustomReportItem
The following is the XML Schema definition of the CustomReportItem.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0" />
